[spoiler=[b]Nordiheim military developments[/b]]
[u][b]Drake Fire testing.[/b][/u]
A 3 day live fire test of the Drake Fire DEW was successfully done ageinst dumy drones in ostland, the test was both to see the systems ability to stay on target and to test its endurance over multible "encounters" to see how its parts and software would handle it.
While the result was good it will still be some years before a propper production model is going to be created, there is still alternative components that needs testing as a few of the current ones are not optimal for logistics reasons and its software still needs aditional target "data" to be aquired for the automatic part aswell as system integration.

[u][b]Platypus turret changes.[/b][/u]
A few prototype turrets have been made and installed on modefied Platypus 1Bs for testing were the 105mm configuration have showed good results in its preformance, but the 120mm have not been as willing to work as desired.

Its first iteration had stability and recoil problems when fired, especialy to the sides were the vehicle ones almoust tipped over when fired up a hill while the vehicle itself also was on the side of said hill (basicly it almoust flipped over to roll down the hill side), as such the Karlson Company and Steel Boats Inc. cooperation installed a gun recoil mechanism designed for a larger cannon to absorbe this force to hopefully overcome this problem.

Unfortunatly the larger recoil mechanism that was needed to deal with the forces of the gun fireing would remove its ability to get the guns line of fire any lower then compleatly horizontaly, a result that the Nordiheimian military isn't to keen on, the two companies are now looking into how to either fix this problem or find a new potential use for it to salvage the time and money they have put into the project.

[u][b]New CIWS weapon?[/b][/u]
The nationaly owned Nordiheims Arms company have reported to the military that they are in the prosses of making a new CIWS that have longer range and potentialy more utility then the older Tyr-1 Automatic AA module.
It is being designed and built around a new 35 mm revolver cannon, this size of cannon will allow it a desired mix of range, rate of fire and shells large enough to make AHEAD ammuntions for.

Because of the complexity needed for its targeting and fire system the Nordiheims Arms company have asked AIS-Corp. for its expertice on such systems.
The name curently given to this new CIWS weapon is the "Frigg A35CIWS Module", it is hoped that it can be used on multible platforms though its first intended use is on naval ships.

[u][b]Project Sif[/b][/u]
Whit the declaration from the minister of war that the Nordiheim navy is to be expanded aswell as the R&D of the navy being tasked with looking into creating new ships, especialy for anti-air duty, the Nordrlandi Shipyard Company have approched the military with a ship design that some of their more exentric engineers have been tinkering with for a few years called the Sif-class.

The small ship, no longer then 73.2 meters, is designed to be a multi purpose corvette type hull that can be fitted with multible possible weapons and systems on its construction, aswell as being easy to change things on in refits.
This allows the base design to be used for several configurations by making subclasses for it.

Its bigest selling point at this time is the fact that its design allows for it to potentialy use the new CIWS weapon that are being made with little need of change and the fact that it has space for extra sensor and targeting equipment if needed.
It is also hoped that by making use of the hull for more then one type of ship its cost can be kept from getting to high trough large production scale.

The minister of war and the rest of the council, and their teams of experts & advisors, discused at lenght how to potentialy bring up future production numbers to achive a "large production scale" and potential extra expertise to make it a design with a long lifespan.
They came up with two avenues, to aproche the nations of [nation]United Hydronia[/nation] aswell as the nation of [nation]BR Bob[/nation].
The Hydronians were realy a natural choice as they had made a naval cooperation agreement with them not to long ago [i][u](The A4 Naval Cooperation)[/u][/i] and this would easely fall under its scope.
The Bobians on the other hand they had no such deal, but it would be foolish not to try and gauge their interest, they were no slouch in the matter of naval technology and were a friendly nation that was gicing their expertice and advice to Nordiheim in their future ambitions of having their own native carriers, as such they would be asked if they were interested in this new ship.

A diplomatic team would be sendt to both nations for this purpose, these teams would each be joined by a representative from the creators of the design aswell as a military diplomatic envoy.
[/spoiler]
